task: Write a Python function using boto3 that takes an S3 bucket name and returns the total number of objects stored in that bucket, handling pagination so that buckets with more than 1,000 objects are counted correctly.

Create a JSON IAM policy document that allows read-only access (s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket) to a single S3 bucket named 'analytics-reports-prod' and denies all actions on objects under the 'confidential/' prefix.
Write a regex that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs (for example, i-0abcd1234efgh5678), which begin with 'i-' followed by either 8 or 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
